name: Bongard-OpenWorld
description: A benchmark for evaluating few-shot reasoning on real-world free-form visual concepts, requiring models to identify visual concepts from positive and negative image sets with open vocabulary and real-world images.
reputation: A newer but increasingly cited benchmark in visual reasoning research, especially for open-world concept induction beyond closed-set classification.
notes: Introduces open-world free-form concepts and real-world images; current models lag behind human performance.
